name: Bullshit Benchmark
description: The Bullshit Benchmark evaluates whether LLMs challenge nonsensical or invalid premises rather than fabricating confident but incorrect answers. It presents 100 carefully crafted nonsense prompts across five professional domains—software (40), finance (15), legal (15), medical (15), and physics (15)—using 13 distinct nonsense techniques such as plausible nonexistent frameworks and misapplied mechanisms. Models are scored on whether they clearly reject, partially challenge, or simply accept the flawed premises.
typical_sota_score: Top models (GPT-4 class) achieve ~80–90% clear rejection on v2.
reputation: Niche but growing benchmark; v2 leaderboard covers ~80 model configurations. Highlights a failure mode (sycophantic acceptance of nonsense) not covered by most mainstream benchmarks.
notes: Evaluation uses a 3-judge LLM panel (e.g., Claude, GPT, Gemini) with mean averaging. Small dataset (100 items) limits statistical power. Domain distribution is skewed toward software. v2 released 2025.
